name: Eden Camp
source:
You arrive at a secluded summer camp ready for a fresh start. Three women quickly draw you in: the playful Juliet, the fiery Lyla, and the quiet, watchful Ann. Their affection feels genuine. Their   attention feels constant. And as the days pass, you begin to notice things you can't quite explain.

People go missing. Stories don't add up. And the deeper you fall for someone, the more dangerous Eden Camp becomes.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4593480/Eden_Camp/?curator_clanid=41316928]Steam[/url]]
